_cast_aibasic: Deep Learners AI club, Hanbit High School; students wear navy Korean school uniforms (navy blazer, white shirt, striped tie). Seojun: boy, short neat black hair with a cowlick, round black glasses, carries a small spiral notebook. Jia: girl, high black ponytail with a yellow scrunchie, rosy cheeks, bright smile. Minho: tall boy, messy brown spiky hair, loosened tie, red hoodie under blazer, mischievous grin. Harin: girl, long straight black hair, thin silver glasses, cream cardigan, calm expression. Ms. Kang: advisor teacher, woman in her late thirties, chin-length bob, beige blazer, teal blouse, blank lanyard card.
aibasic/1-1-1: First meeting of the Deep Learners AI club in a bright Korean high school club room. Ms. Kang stands beside a large screen showing a car driving itself down a road with an empty driver's seat and no hands on the wheel. Jia raises her hand with a puzzled, curious look, while Seojun, Minho and Harin lean forward watching. Behind them a chalkboard holds unreadable chalk scribbles and a simple sketch of a robot head.
aibasic/1-1-2: Early Saturday morning in a cozy Korean apartment kitchen. Seojun sits at the breakfast table beside his mother, who holds out her smartphone showing a glowing red warning shield icon about a blocked late-night overseas card payment. A dark night-sky moon motif glows on the screen. Seojun leans in, puzzled and intrigued, wondering how anyone noticed while everyone slept. Soft morning sunlight comes through the window.
aibasic/1-1-3: Saturday morning on a busy Seoul subway platform with tiled walls. Seojun, Jia, Minho and Harin huddle together, debating which way to go. Seojun holds up a smartphone showing a colorful subway map with three highlighted route lines. Minho points one direction, Jia points the other, and Harin calmly studies the phone screen. Commuters blur past and a train glides into the station behind them.
aibasic/1-2-1: In the club room, Seojun sketches a branching tree diagram across an open notebook, each branch decorated with tiny drawings of a farmer, a wolf, a sheep and a cabbage in a little boat. Jia traces one branch all the way down with her finger, while Minho sweeps his hand across the top row of branches. Harin watches thoughtfully. A tablet on the desk shows a cartoon river crossing puzzle.
aibasic/1-2-2: On a misty wooded hill behind a Korean neighborhood, Seojun and his father stand on a small rocky knoll, the father raising both arms in triumph. As the fog lifts, a much taller true summit is revealed across the valley, and Seojun points at it with wide eyes and a sheepish half-laugh. Every path from their little knoll slopes downward. Cool, pale morning light.
aibasic/1-2-3: In the club room, Minho leans back with a smug, confident grin after winning yet another game of tic-tac-toe drawn on paper with crosses and circles, a pile of finished game sheets beside him. Seojun frowns in frustration across the desk while Jia and Harin watch, amused. On a laptop nearby, a map shows two winding routes, one of them clogged with red traffic.
aibasic/1-2-4: Ms. Kang stands at the club room chalkboard covered in three lines of unreadable chalk scribbles, beside small chalk drawings of a virus, a tomato, and a robot head next to a human head. She turns to the students with a challenging smile. Seojun scratches his head, Jia and Minho think hard, and Harin taps her chin. A smart speaker on the desk glows faintly, as if confused.
aibasic/1-2-5: Evening on a Korean city street after cram school. Inside a car stopped at a red light just before a right turn, Seojun's father grips the wheel, looking slightly unsure, while Seojun watches from the passenger seat. Pedestrians cross a striped crosswalk ahead under glowing streetlights, and the traffic signal glows red. Seojun wonders how a self-driving car would know such tricky rules.
aibasic/2-1-1: In the club room, Ms. Kang points to a long poster of a temperature line chart that wiggles upward and then stops short, leaving a blank stretch of empty space for the future. Jia holds up her phone showing an endless scroll of recommended video thumbnails of cats and sneakers. Seojun, Minho and Harin look between the empty space and the phone, puzzled.
aibasic/2-1-2: In the club room, a laptop shows a photo of a giraffe tagged with a glowing cat-face icon. Jia stands behind a towering stack of printed photos of her grey cat, Minho has a small pile of puppy photos, and Seojun holds a few zoo snapshots. They stare at the screen, stunned and laughing. Harin, empty-handed, raises a calm eyebrow while Ms. Kang writes on the whiteboard.
aibasic/2-1-3: In the club room, Minho stares in dismay at a laptop showing a large spreadsheet of survey answers riddled with empty grey cells. Jia makes a sweeping wipe-it-all-away gesture, Seojun shakes his head with a worried look, and Harin holds a second printed survey file to merge. Ms. Kang points at the columns, suggesting they sort the kinds of data first.
aibasic/2-1-4: In the club room, Harin frowns at a laptop showing a bar chart of student heights where one bar shoots absurdly off the top of the screen. Seojun laughs and points at it. In the doorway, a very tall basketball team senior in a sports jersey ducks under the frame, making everyone wonder whether real tall values should be removed too. Ms. Kang watches with a knowing smile.
aibasic/2-1-5: Seojun sits at a table in his uncle's small Korean restaurant, a cardboard box of crumpled paper receipts spilled across it and a laptop showing a table of columns. Jia gestures to use everything, Harin carefully picks out one receipt, and Minho squints at a receipt's printed weekday abbreviations, puzzled. Steam rises from the kitchen behind them in the warm, cluttered space.
aibasic/2-1-6: On a sunny school lawn, Jia kneels and gives a treat to her small fluffy puppy, which sits obediently. Minho and Seojun crouch nearby, curious, while Harin points toward a classroom window where a new transfer student sits among a cluster of classmates during break time. A cheerful, warm afternoon mood.
aibasic/2-1-7: In the club room, Harin proudly turns a laptop toward her friends; the screen shows a big glowing green checkmark beside a crowd of tiny person icons where a handful are highlighted red and left uncircled. Minho, still clutching a worn, memorized workbook, looks skeptical. Ms. Kang draws a large two-by-two grid of empty boxes on the whiteboard, while Jia and Seojun lean in.
aibasic/2-1-8: On a Korean high school baseball field, Harin sits in the dugout with Seojun, Jia and Minho, spreading out a printed table of players covered in unreadable scribbles. A boy in a baseball uniform has just handed it over. Behind them, a new coach with a clipboard watches players batting and pitching. Minho waves confidently, Seojun looks thoughtful, Jia looks hopeful.
aibasic/2-1-9: In the club room, Seojun studies a large printout of an old 19th-century city street map dotted with small black bars clustered around a water pump symbol. Harin points to the dense cluster of marks. On the whiteboard, Ms. Kang has drawn a straight line through scattered dots and, beside it, circled the dots into three groups. Minho and Jia compare the two drawings.
aibasic/2-2-1: In the club room, a large screen shows blue dots in the center surrounded by a ring of orange dots like a donut, with a straight boundary line slicing awkwardly through them. Seojun, who confidently said one line would do, stares with his smile faltering. Ms. Kang stands by the screen holding a marker, beside a sketch of small connected circles like neurons. Jia, Minho and Harin watch.
aibasic/2-2-2: Evening before midterms in the club room. Jia sits with an open workbook and red pen while Minho grins, suggesting she grade everything at once. Ms. Kang smiles knowingly beside a screen showing a simple network diagram of connected circles, where one arrow glows red and points backward. Jia glances at her mistake notebook, thinking. Warm lamplight fills the room.
aibasic/2-2-3: In the club room, Minho holds up a parcel delivery label covered in messy handwritten pen scribbles. On a big screen, Ms. Kang displays a grid of small blurry handwritten pen-stroke images. The students split into two teams facing each other across desks: Seojun confidently leading one side, Harin skeptically crossing her arms on the other, with Jia cheering. A playful competitive mood.
aibasic/2-2-4: In the club room, a large screen shows a photo of an elegant banquet hall with colored rectangular boxes drawn around people, chairs, tables and vases, but a huge sparkling crystal chandelier and a tall gilded mirror have no boxes at all. Jia points up at the chandelier, puzzled, while Harin and Seojun look closely. Ms. Kang stands nearby with a mysterious smile.
aibasic/2-2-5: In the club room, Minho nervously reads a tongue twister aloud into Harin's smartphone, which shows a glowing sound waveform and lines of unreadable transcribed scribbles with a couple of words highlighted red. Seojun holds up a crayon drawing of a giraffe, grinning. Harin watches the phone calmly, and Ms. Kang looks on with a thoughtful expression.
aibasic/2-2-6: In the club room, Jia sits hunched over her phone, typing to a chatbot with a hopeful but anxious face, glancing at Harin, who sits quietly apart by the window after their argument. Seojun leans over Jia's shoulder, curious. Floating faintly above the phone, translucent icons of a cat and a fish hover close together. Ms. Kang hands out articles with their headlines covered by paper.
aibasic/2-2-7: At night on a Korean street lit by colorful neon karaoke signs without readable lettering, Seojun walks beside Minho, teasing him with a sly half-compliment. Harin walks with them, frowning at her phone, which shows a big sad frowning face icon as an analysis result. Jia is typing on her own phone. Minho looks confused, unsure whether he was praised or insulted.
aibasic/3-1-1: In the club room, Jia pins a printed news clipping onto the bulletin board: a picture of an ornate, dreamlike painted artwork beside a golden trophy. Minho tilts his head, puzzled about who deserves the prize, while Seojun and Harin study the clipping. Nearby hangs an old photo of a huge vintage computer filling an entire room, contrasting with the smartphones in their hands.
aibasic/3-1-2: Morning in a narrow, sharply bending alley in front of a Korean high school. A car suddenly darts out from around the blind corner, and Seojun, carrying his schoolbag, jumps back in alarm. A round convex traffic mirror on a pole stands unnoticed at the corner. Other students in uniforms walk nearby, and low walls and power lines line the alley.
aibasic/3-1-3: In a Korean classroom, Seojun sits at his desk with a career survey form, his pencil frozen above an empty box, a translation app glowing on his phone beside an English workbook. Next to him, Minho scratches his head, looking glum. Through the window, an ordinary street. Seojun's expression is uncertain and a little anxious, thinking about future jobs.
aibasic/3-2-1: In a cozy Korean living room, a seven-year-old girl cousin snuggles happily against a glowing smart speaker that is reading her a bedtime story, a picture book open in her lap. Jia sits nearby holding another picture book, looking a little hurt and thoughtful. Soft evening lamplight and toys scattered on the floor create a warm but bittersweet mood.
aibasic/3-2-2: In a traditional countryside Korean home with sliding paper doors, an elderly grandmother in a floral cardigan leans toward a new smart speaker, asking it to play a song, while the speaker glows with a confused pulsing light. Seojun kneels beside her, wincing awkwardly, since the speaker understood him instantly. A gift box and ribbon lie on the floor mat.
aibasic/3-2-3: In the club room, Ms. Kang has paused a video on the screen showing a self-driving car speeding toward a crosswalk where an elderly man stands on one side and a small child on the other. Jia, Minho and Seojun are deep in debate with conflicted, uneasy expressions, and Harin looks down thoughtfully. A tense, serious mood with no right answer.
aibasic/3-2-4: In the club room, a screen shows a news-style image of a test self-driving vehicle with roof-mounted sensors stopped on a dark road at night, emergency lights glowing in the distance. Harin, Seojun and Jia each point in different directions, arguing about who is responsible. Ms. Kang stands at a chalkboard with three underlined unreadable words, her expression serious.
aibasic/4-1-1: First club meeting of the second semester. Ms. Kang stands beside a screen showing bleached white coral reefs and a cleared patch of rainforest, plus an old smartphone strapped to a tree trunk. Minho tilts his head, puzzled. Behind her, a whiteboard shows five empty boxes connected by arrows, waiting to be filled. Seojun, Jia and Harin look determined but a bit overwhelmed.
aibasic/4-1-2: In the club room, Ms. Kang hands out five role cards with simple icons. Seojun holds his card, while a laptop shows a cartoon penguin with measurement lines along its beak and flipper, next to a spreadsheet with gaps and stray dots. An old phone lies on the desk. Jia, Minho and Harin hold their cards, comparing two different model results with surprise.
aibasic/4-2-1: In the club room, Ms. Kang shows a world map shaded in varying colors by country. On a laptop, Jia, Seojun, Minho and Harin scroll through an enormous spreadsheet with countless rows and scattered blank cells, plus a column of words. They hesitate, nobody sure whether to fill the blanks or delete rows. A phone photo of a grandmother's birthday party lies beside the laptop.
aibasic/4-2-2: In the club room, Ms. Kang sketches four kinds of charts on the whiteboard: a bar chart, a colorful checkerboard heatmap, a cloud of scattered dots, and a violin-shaped plot. Jia raises her hand with an eager question, while Seojun and Harin sit before a laptop filled with endless rows of numbers, looking relieved that pictures might help. Minho grins at the violin shape.
aibasic/4-2-3: In the club room, Seojun sits at a laptop showing a single large glowing gauge filled about four-fifths of the way, with a long column of tiny unreadable values beside it. Minho grins, treating it like a test score, while Seojun looks unsure. Harin points to two separated stacks of data cards labeled only by color, one for study and one for testing.
aibasic/4-3-1: In the club room, Jia stares in surprise at her laptop, where a wildfire photo has loaded with the flames rendered an eerie blue instead of orange. Seojun and Minho lean in, astonished, beside a messy folder of mixed thumbnails of fires and ordinary landscapes. Ms. Kang stands behind them with a knowing smile. A window shows a calm spring sky.
aibasic/4-3-2: In the club room, Ms. Kang slowly moves a large magnifying glass across a printed photo of a forest fire pinned to the board, a small three-by-three grid sketched in chalk beside it. On a desk laptop, a line graph climbs steadily upward as training runs. Seojun, Jia, Minho and Harin watch the magnifier with fascination.
aibasic/4-3-3: In the club room, Harin playfully holds up her phone with a photo of the red brick library in front of the school, while a laptop flags it with a glowing flame warning icon. Minho laughs. Seojun has stopped scrolling a folder full of almost identical orange-red thumbnails, his expression dawning with realization. Thumbnails of autumn maple mountains, a fire truck and a sunset also show flame icons.
datascience/1-1-1: In a Korean high school astronomy club room at night, an older club senior proudly shows a tall stack of about thirty worn observation notebooks. A curious first-year Korean high school girl leafs through one, full of handwritten tables (unreadable scribbles) and sketches of moon phases and a bright planet. A telescope stands by the open window under a starry sky, and a small portrait of a 16th-century astronomer hangs on the wall.
datascience/1-1-2: In a Korean high school classroom three weeks before the school festival, students argue over the food booth menu. A boy class president points to a sketch of spicy rice cakes, while a girl holds up a cup of colorful slushie. Others shrug and argue from gut feeling. A quiet Korean high school girl sits apart with a notebook and a small coin pouch, determined to bring real data next time.
datascience/1-1-3: In a Korean school cafeteria, three Korean high school students crowd around a tablet, swiping through hundreds of lunch tray photos taken from the same angle. Some photos are dark and blurry, and a dish of red-sauced meat could be pork or chicken. The boy who took them looks proud, a girl frowns, and on the wall hangs a neat monthly meal calendar grid with unreadable entries.
datascience/1-1-4: In a Korean school staff room, a homeroom teacher sits before a monitor showing a table of neat columns with unreadable entries. A Korean high school boy points proudly at a computed average in one column, while a girl helping beside him looks unsure. The teacher raises an eyebrow and gestures between two imaginary steps on a staircase, questioning whether the gaps are really equal.
datascience/1-2-1: In a Korean school library at lunchtime, two students at separate laptops type into the same shared spreadsheet at the same moment. A Korean high school girl gasps as her entry vanishes from a row. Book carts and shelves surround them. The librarian teacher approaches holding a single sheet of old Korean paper beside a heap of ancient document bundles, smiling thoughtfully.
datascience/1-2-2: In a Korean high school film club room decorated with abstract film reel posters, a girl club president frowns at a laptop showing a very long spreadsheet where only half of the matching rows are highlighted. A boy club member nearby looks guilty, holding a pencil after fixing one typo. Scattered DVD cases and a projector sit on the table. Puzzled, slightly frustrated mood.
datascience/1-2-3: In a modern Korean school library, a Korean high school girl stands at a new search kiosk whose screen fills instantly with rows of colorful book cover thumbnails. Behind the circulation desk, the librarian teacher types on a monitor with a black background and lines of glowing code (unreadable), raising one finger in a serious, cautionary gesture. Bookshelves stretch behind them.
datascience/1-2-4: In a Korean high school career class, a teacher stands beside a projected slide with three empty answer boxes and a photo of a dusty rural classroom. Nearly all twenty-eight students raise their hands for one option, while a single boy alone raises his hand for a different one. A Korean high school girl in the front row turns around, surprised.
datascience/2-1-1: In a Korean school nutrition office, a kind nutritionist teacher in a white apron looks over a stack of paper surveys and a small set-aside pile, asking a gentle but probing question. A Korean high school girl with a student council armband stands before her, holding a bar chart with two towering bars, her confidence wavering. Through the window, students crowd in front of the school snack shop.
datascience/2-1-2: At night, a Korean high school girl sits at her desk before a laptop showing an endless spreadsheet with cryptic column headers (unreadable). A health checkup sheet and a bathroom scale lie nearby. Her friend leans over her shoulder, pointing confidently at a column containing only two kinds of values, while she looks doubtful. A teacher's sticky note hangs on the monitor.
datascience/2-1-3: A tired Korean high school boy with dark circles under his eyes sits at his desk, a smartwatch lying beside his laptop. The screen shows a sleep bar chart where one bar towers absurdly tall and several days are empty gaps. He frowns in confusion. Beside him, a friend's phone shows sleep records written in messy, inconsistent formats.
datascience/2-1-4: In a Korean high school health classroom, a Korean high school girl holds up a printed line graph where one line wildly zigzags across the top while the other lines lie flat along the bottom. A pie chart lies on her desk. Her teacher leans in, asking what she wants the graph to say. Step counters and sleep logs from five friends are spread out.
datascience/2-2-1: At a Korean family dinner table, a Korean high school boy eagerly shows his mother a printed survey chart of classmates' allowances: many short bars and one absurdly tall bar at the end. His mother raises a skeptical eyebrow, chopsticks paused in midair. Coins and a few banknotes lie beside the rice bowls. Hopeful versus doubtful expressions.
datascience/2-2-2: On a hot summer evening, a Korean high school girl sits at her desk with a notebook of daily sleep and stress logs (unreadable scribbles). Her excited younger brother bursts into the room holding a small electric fan in one hand and a dripping ice cream cone in the other, proudly announcing his theory. She laughs but looks puzzled.
datascience/2-2-3: In a Korean apartment, two sisters sit together at a laptop browsing lodging photos: a cramped room with four bunk beds and a cozy room with two beds. A Korean high school girl and her older sister debate, one counting on her fingers per person. A map of Europe with colorful pins, a backpack and a travel guidebook lie beside them.
datascience/2-2-4: In a Korean apartment, two sisters argue playfully in front of two laptops, each showing a different spreadsheet of city data that needs combining. The older sister holds a postcard of a grand European city with a clock tower; the Korean high school girl holds postcards of cheaper old cities with a river and ancient ruins. Sticky notes with abstract symbols cover the desk.
datascience/3-1-1: Inside a small summer ice cream shop near a Korean high school, the middle-aged owner shows a Korean high school girl working part-time a worn notebook full of handwritten tables (unreadable scribbles). A freezer case of colorful ice cream glows beside them, and a small TV shows a weather forecast with a blazing sun icon. The owner smiles knowingly; the girl looks amazed.
datascience/3-1-2: In a Korean high school club room the night before a presentation, three students sit side by side at laptops: a girl with a spreadsheet chart, a boy with a code editor full of lines, and a third student connecting colorful widget circles with lines. All three screens show nearly identical rising line charts. They look at each other, surprised. A clock on the wall without numerals.
datascience/3-1-3: At a Korean kitchen table three weeks before exams, a mother sits with arms crossed in negotiation while her teenage son turns his laptop toward her, showing a scatter plot where dots rise roughly along a straight line. A game controller and a pile of survey papers lie on the table. Tense but playful negotiation mood.
datascience/3-1-4: At a Korean holiday dinner table covered with traditional dishes, an aunt with glasses (a statistics professor) and an uncle in a hoodie with a laptop (an AI developer) debate passionately across the food. A Korean high school girl sits between them, looking back and forth, intrigued. Other relatives chat in the background in a warm home.
datascience/3-2-1: In a Korean high school student council office, a Korean high school girl sits behind a tall pile of paper surveys, looking at her laptop where a scatter plot shows dots clumped into several natural clusters. She tilts her head hopefully, pen in hand, wondering whether the computer could circle the groups for her.
datascience/3-2-2: In a Korean student council meeting room, two Korean high school students hold up printed scatter plots side by side: one with three colored clusters, one widely spread out, and another with five clusters where two blobs touch. They argue earnestly. Between them, the older council president laughs and raises a fist for rock-paper-scissors. A long table with snacks.
datascience/3-2-3: In a Korean supermarket meat section, a Korean high school boy in a store apron watches a customer's basket holding a pack of pork belly, a tub of soybean dipping paste, and an unbranded cola bottle. The store manager is placing stacks of paste tubs right next to the meat counter. Bright fluorescent lighting and busy shoppers.
datascience/3-2-4: In a Korean high school teachers' office, a head teacher shows a laptop with an enormous grid of colorful subject combination tiles. A Korean high school girl stares, overwhelmed, scratching her head, while the teacher smiles and fades out a few rarely chosen tiles with a fingertip. Stacks of course request forms with unreadable writing sit on the desk.
datascience/4-1-1: In the yard of a grandmother's countryside Korean house after the rainy season, a firefighter in protective gear carefully removes a large hornet nest from under the tiled eaves. A Korean high school girl and her grandmother watch from a safe distance, the girl curious and thoughtful. Green summer foliage, damp ground and puddles.
datascience/4-1-2: In a Korean school library, a Korean high school girl from the library club sits with printouts of loan records, odd entries circled in red pen. One friend holds up a phone as if to secretly record students chatting nearby, another shows a laptop with a mysterious downloaded file. The girl looks uneasy and hesitant.
datascience/4-1-3: Late at night before final exams, a tired Korean high school girl sits at her desk, her phone glowing with a flood of group chat notifications. Her laptop shows a messy survey spreadsheet with blank cells and mismatched entries (unreadable). An alarm clock, energy drink and textbooks surround her. Exhausted yet determined mood.
datascience/4-1-4: In a cozy Korean living room, a Korean high school girl sits at a laptop showing a tidy scatter plot of dots. Around her, her grandmother holds up a pillow, her mother waves a smartphone accusingly, and a PE teacher on a video call on a tablet holds a jump rope, each insisting on their own theory. The girl looks at her data, curious which side it supports.
datascience/4-2-1: In a Korean high school film club room, students playfully place bets by pinning paper tokens onto a board of abstract upcoming movie posters with no text. A Korean high school boy sits at a laptop with many browser windows showing scattered review pages as blurred lines, looking determined to predict with data this time.
datascience/4-2-2: In a Korean high school film club room with abstract movie posters on the walls, students cheer at a laptop showing a nearly full green gauge, while one Korean high school girl points to a second indicator glowing warning orange below it, frowning. Mixed emotions of celebration and doubt. Popcorn and printed review highlights lie on the table.
datascience/4-2-3: In a Korean high school model United Nations club room, students sit at desks with small blank colored placards, debating seriously. A world map is projected on the screen, and a glass jar of golden tokens on the table represents an aid fund. A teacher points toward a laptop showing a long data table, while one Korean high school girl looks thoughtful.
datascience/4-2-4: In a Korean high school club room, students stand before a large world map colored in patches of red, yellow and green. A laptop shows two versions of the same map with the colors mismatched, the same countries in different colors. A Korean high school boy and girl compare them, puzzled, wondering which grouping to trust.
